  <h1>Everything<br>Built On Jev</h1>
  <p class="sub">Repos, SDKs, integrations, demos and benchmarks for TypeSafe AI's System One model. Stars refreshed daily from GitHub.</p>

  <div class="band-inner frame">
    <span class="marks" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <h2 class="giant">1,094 Entries,<br>81,237 Stars.</h2>
    <p class="footnote">*1,007 GitHub repos, 352 live sites, 51 articles and threads. Refreshed 2026-09-24.</p>

    <div class="band-grid">
      <div class="win spec">
        <div class="win-bar"><span>JEV · SPEC SHEET</span><span class="win-bar-r">v1.13</span></div>
        <table class="kv">
          <tr><th>model</th><td>jev-latest</td></tr>
          <tr><th>endpoint</th><td>POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone</td></tr>
          <tr><th>input</th><td>state + typed questions, evaluated in parallel</td></tr>
          <tr><th>output</th><td>typed answers, per-option probabilities, confidence</td></tr>
          <tr><th>latency</th><td>70–500 ms end to end (per TypeSafe)</td></tr>
          <tr><th>pricing</th><td>$0.042 / MTok input · output free</td></tr>
          <tr><th>sdks</th><td><a href="https://github.com/typesafe-ai/typesafe-sdk-js">js</a> · <a href="https://github.com/typesafe-ai/typesafe-sdk-python">python</a> · <a href="https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/jev">ai gateway</a> · community below</td></tr>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div class="win prim">
        <div class="win-bar"><span>PRIMITIVES</span><span class="win-bar-r">3</span></div>
        <table class="kv">
          <tr><th>choice</th><td>pick one option from a list → <code>choice</code>, <code>probabilities</code>, <code>confidence</code></td></tr>
          <tr><th>score</th><td>rate the state on a rubric → <code>score</code>, <code>probabilities</code>, <code>confidence</code></td></tr>
          <tr><th>noul</th><td>is this statement true? → <code>noul</code> (0–1)</td></tr>
        </table>
        <pre class="code"><code><span class="c-k">import</span> { choice, TypeSafeClient } <span class="c-k">from</span> <span class="c-s">"@typesafe-ai/sdk"</span>;

<span class="c-k">const</span> client = <span class="c-k">new</span> TypeSafeClient();
<span class="c-k">const</span> response = <span class="c-k">await</span> client.systemOne({
  state: { document: <span class="c-s">"I was charged twice. Please fix this ASAP."</span> },
  questions: {
    category: choice(<span class="c-s">"What is this ticket about?"</span>, {
      billing: <span class="c-n">null</span>,
      technical: <span class="c-n">null</span>,
      other: <span class="c-n">null</span>,
    }),
  },
});

console.log(response.answers.category.choice);</code></pre>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
